description: This file defines the LogView class, a custom Android TextView used for displaying log data. It implements the LogNode interface to format and output log messages within an Android application.

classes.name: LogView
classes.description: A custom TextView that displays log messages received through the LogNode interface. It formats log data, handles UI thread updates, and chains to the next LogNode if set.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Formats log message components (priority, tag, message, exception) and appends the result to the LogView. Also forwards log data to the next LogNode if configured.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: appendIfNotNull
methods.description: Helper method that appends a string to a StringBuilder with a delimiter if the string is not null or empty.

methods.name: appendToLog
methods.description: Appends a string as a new line to the LogView display.
